description: Extracts the design system the page actually uses: palette with contrast audit, type scale, radii, shadows and spacing. Use it to match a new component to an existing product, or to find accessibility problems in the live UI. Ask for "markdown" when the answer should outlive the conversation: it returns a design document to commit beside the code, dated, because a snapshot with no date on it eventually becomes a lie.

format.description: Output shape. "css" emits custom properties, "markdown" a DESIGN.md the team can commit so the next question about spacing does not need the browser again.

name: get_design_tokens
title: Colours, type and spacing
